notes.title: 0.0.12b Update - New Map Tutorial, UI Refinement, and Gameplay Enhancements!
notes.content:
[url=v0.0.12b][img]https://i.imgur.com/LXZ5T1R.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Greetings Survivors,[/h2]

We're excited to roll out the v0.0.12b beta update for [i]*End of Everything*[/i]! This update includes several visual and gameplay improvements designed to enhance your overall experience. Here’s what’s new in this version:

[h3]UI Refinement and Visual Enhancements:[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Main Menu Overhaul:[/b] The main menu scene has been revamped with improved lighting, sky, weather effects, and time progression to showcase the game's detailed environment. We’ve also added a Latest News UI board to keep you updated with the latest information. Additionally, the UI layout has been restructured for better accessibility.
[*][b]Player UI Refinement:[/b] The looted items overlay has been repositioned to the mid-lower center of the screen for convenience. We've also moved the vitals for HP/Thirst/Hunger and updated the HP icon.
[*][b]Inventory UI Refinements:[/b] The crafting layout is now positioned on the right side of the inventory screen, while the holster/character section has been moved to the left.
[*][b]Color Scheme and Fonts:[/b] We've updated the color scheme to match the horror elements, moving away from white text to something more fitting. More fonts have also been switched to the new style for consistency.
[*][b]Splash Screen Fix:[/b] The Happy Dayz Games splash screen at the start of the game has been fixed.
[/list]

[h3]Gameplay Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]New Items and Crafting Changes:[/b] The war grenade has been removed for the moment, and we've added a handcrafted wooden torch.
[*][b]Fall Damage Adjustment:[/b] Fall damage has been adjusted, doubling the height from which you can fall before taking damage.
[*][b]New Map Tutorial:[/b] A new map tutorial has been added to help new players grasp the game before stepping into the Lake map.
[*][b]Fixed Axe and Storage:[/b] We've addressed issues with the axe and storage system.
[*][b]Added Compass:[/b] A compass has been added for better navigation.
[*][b]Zombie Adjustments:[/b] 
[list]
[*]Zombie respawn/despawn timer has been fixed to 10 minutes (previously 3 minutes).
[*]Fixed zombie wander time and range.
[*]Altered zombie chase SFX.
[*]Zombies now drop clothes, bones, and occasionally rare items.
[/list]
[*][b]Weather Effects:[/b] Weather effects, such as rain, now follow the player properly.
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Building Book UI:[/b] All issues with the Building Book UI have been resolved.
[/list]

[h3]World and AI Improvements:[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]New Resource Nodes:[/b] Boulders and rock piles have been added as resource nodes, randomly spawned throughout the world, similar to how trees are generated.
[*][b]AI Refinements:[/b] We've refined the enemy AI script to be less obscure, with improved pathing and fewer bugs. However, further testing is required on varying terrain elevations.
[/list]

We’re committed to improving [i]*End of Everything*[/i] and hope you enjoy these updates. Please continue to share your feedback and report any issues you encounter.

Thank you for being part of our journey!

[b]Happy surviving,[/b]  
[b]The Happy Dayz Games Team[/b]

notes.title: End of Everything v0.0.11b Beta Update - New Map & Enhancements!
notes.content:
Greetings Survivors,

We are thrilled to announce the release of the [b]v0.0.11b beta update[/b] for [i]End of Everything[/i]! This update introduces a brand new main map called [b]Lake[/b]. Dive into an expansive environment featuring beautifully crafted paths, lush vegetation, detailed buildings, and serene water bodies. Here's what you can expect in this latest update:

[b]New Content:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]New Main Map: Lake[/b] - Explore paths, vegetation, buildings, and water features in our newest map.
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/5GxcKJ9.png[/img]

[b]Visual Enhancements:[/b]
[list]
[*]Adjusted [b]darkness levels[/b] for a more immersive night experience.
[*][b]Morning sunlight rays[/b] have been fine-tuned for better visuals.
[*][b]Extended day and night cycles[/b] to enhance realism and gameplay experience.
[/list]

[b]User Interface and Settings:[/b]
[list]
[*]Reduced [b]font size[/b] in the game menu for better readability.
[*]Added [b]resolution/apply options[/b] directly in the in-game menu for easy access.
[*]Added possible [b]mouse sensitivity settings[/b] for better control.
[/list]

[b]Fixes and Optimizations:[/b]
[list]
[*]Various [b]UI and font fixes[/b] for a smoother interface.
[*]Reduced the game [b]download size[/b] to 3.5GB from over 5GB.
[*]Adjusted [b]day-night cycle ratios[/b] to 1.2 for day and 0.8 for night, with a total cycle duration of 45 minutes.
[/list]

We hope these changes will enhance your gameplay experience. As always, your feedback is invaluable to us, so please keep it coming!

Thank you for your continued support!

Happy surviving,

[b]The Happy Dayz Games Team[/b]
